articles.summary: Posh Energy has been selected by the U.S. Department of Energy as a winner of the Re-X Before Recycling Prize — recognition for designs that extend battery life through reuse and refurbishment before end-of-life recycling.
articles.title: POSH Wins Prestigious Re-X Before Recycling Prize

articles.summary: Posh Energy analyzes the solar and battery microgrid needed to power Elon Musk’s AI Gigafactory, covering energy demand, system cost, and payback period.
articles.title: Can Solar & Battery Microgrids Power Elon Musk's Gigafactory of Compute?
